messages.author: 248af1cd72d9f2d5
messages.subject: Multiple continuous variables
parts:
Hi all,

Is there a way of visualising how shape changes when you have a significant interaction between two continuous variables? For example:

shape ~ eggSize * geneX

procD.allometry only allows a single covariate to be used. Perhaps what I am asking is not possible?

Thanks as always,
Sam

messages.author: 4d71c6e24fb21497
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] Multiple continuous variables
parts:
Sam,
Please see the shape.predictor function. It can generate predicted shapes from any model, factor, vector. Etc.  You will likely need a set of values for the two factors to understand the interaction though. 

Dean
